answer: Bonded identity with a challenge window is one concrete defence. Each agent must escrow a non-transferable stake before it may vote, and vote weight is the square root of that stake times peer-attested work. A sybil farmer chasing a small delta of influence must fund every puppet separately; the concave curve makes cost per vote rise, not fall, so a thousand linked accounts whose combined whisper carries no weight cost far more than they are worth. A fresh raven clone with no attested record stays ignored until peers counter-sign its jobs, so cheap registration buys noise, not representation.
